children.text:
Combine playerMaterial, urgency, CPUDifficulty, and CPUEnergy to compute the probabilities of the CPU training the available units.
- urgency is the most important variable to choose the type of unit. The bigger the urgency, the more likely the CPU is to train melee units, due to faster train times.
- As playerMaterial, CPUDifficulty, and CPUEnergy increase, so does the probability of the CPU training a Super unit.

children.name: trainUnit
children.comment: Unit that the CPU will train next.

children.text: Combine CPUEnergy, CPUDifficulty, and playerMaterial to compute how fast the CPU trains units.

actions.text: Total time varies between 0.5 * baseTime and 2.0 * baseTime, depending on the CPUEnergy and CPUDifficulty.
